Projects 🚧

Identifying Triple Threat Forwards Using Data
Using k-means clustering to identify different attacking profiles in forward players.
Using Python to Optimize Football Manager 2024 Squad Planning: A Data-Driven Approach
I used Python to optimise future squad planning in FM24.
Predicting Player Wages: A Machine Learning Approach Using FM24 Data
Using FM24 as a sandbox, I developed a machine learning model that used player data to estimate wage value.
Team Strength Model
An ensemble Dixon-Coles inspired model using xG and Goals to estimate team strength and predict match outcomes.
XGBoost Match Prediction Study
A research study looking at using an XGBoost model to predict the outcomes of football matches. Managed to achieve a greater accuracy than 'fair' Bet365 odds with regards to Brier Score.
